handbook.what: Minutes of practice per student per week for this class, set against the same figure for its school and for everyone doing the course. Dividing by students and by weeks is what lets a class of nine and a class of thirty be compared honestly.
handbook.where: The **Practice min/student/week** card on a class page.
how: Read the top bar for this class's own minutes per student per week.
The bars below it are the school average and the global average for the course.
Compare the lengths — the numbers at the end give the exact figures.
handbook.note: A class with too little practice recorded shows a plain line saying so rather than a bar built from almost nothing.
